comment: Stage 15 test corpus — version-controlled POINTERS + ground truth (the .dem files are large
and live in cold object storage under `storage_ref`). Entries with `recorded: true` carry a
committed sanitized fixture in recorded/<slug>.json from which golden/v<pv>/<slug>.json is
derived; the fast CI gate diffs those. Entries with `recorded: false` are pointers whose
golden gate runs in the `slow` path against the real demo (when present). Covers every Stage
11 case + the active-duty map matrix + a reworked and an unknown map (§15.1).
Regenerate recorded fixtures: scripts/gen_corpus_fixtures.py — goldens: scripts/regen_corpus_goldens.py.
Add a prod parse failure as a reproducer: scripts/add_corpus_reproducer.py.

demos.description: 64-tick Matchmaking GOTV demo on de_inferno — the canonical happy path (models the real demo.dem).
128-tick FACEIT pro demo on de_mirage — exercises the high-tickrate path.
Pro demo on de_nuke (multi-level radar) that went to overtime — final score must exceed regulation.
de_ancient demo with a mid-match disconnect/sub — a round renders with 9 players (anomaly recorded, never a crash).
A POV (client-recorded) demo — must be rejected at the header probe, never parsed.
A truncated/corrupt demo — the parse must fail the job cleanly with a precise error, never crash the worker.
A legacy CSGO (Source 1) demo — rejected pre-parse (CS2-only) at the magic-byte/header check.
A demo on a community/unknown map (de_rats1337) — parses, but has no calibration → unsupported-map state.
Active-duty map matrix — de_dust2 (pointer; golden gate runs in the slow real-demo path).
A reworked map — the de_train rework (new calibration version) must resolve correctly or flag calibration_suspect.
